findings.summary: Acceptance Test AT3 provides insufficient coverage for Requirement R3. R3 mandates usage of "at least CommonMark-compliant syntax," but AT3 only verifies the existence/count of generated files, not the syntactic correctness or compliance of the parsing.

evidence.quote: The system MUST parse each discovered Markdown file using at least CommonMark-compliant syntax...

evidence.note: Test procedure/pass criteria only check file counts, not parsing content.
evidence.quote: Count generated HTML note pages and verify a one-to-one mapping...

findings.summary: Milestone M2 lacks regression testing for core requirements R1, R2, and R3. Although the audit sample checks link these requirements to M2, the plan's M2 exit criteria do not include execution of the corresponding acceptance tests (AT1, AT2, AT3) to ensure the new tag features do not break ingestion or static output.

evidence.note: Exit criteria list new feature tests but omit regression tests for R1-R3.
